title: The Beast You Feed Every Night
logline: At 1:07 AM, a paralyzed young man repeatedly chooses comfort over his dormant ambitions, fueling an obsidian creature of avoidance until silence forces a choice.

scenes.cameraAngle: Eye-level 28mm wide, locked tripod (NO digital zoom)
scenes.focalPoint: Ayo hunched at desk on the right third, surrounded by dark negative space
scenes.compositionNotes: Cold blue monitor glow (#1B2A4A) casts a harsh triangle of light onto Ayo. Left two-thirds of room in oppressive dark navy shadow.
scenes.characterAction: Ayo sits frozen, staring unblinkingly at the blue screen. Minimal 2% chest breathing. Fingers motionless on keyboard.
scenes.audioCue: 60 BPM mechanical clock tick enters at t=0s. 45 Hz sub-bass drone at t=2s.
scenes.caption: It started with one word.

scenes.cameraAngle: Low ground angle, 50mm macro, static camera (NO zoom)
scenes.focalPoint: A pair of clean running shoes and an unopened sketchbook on the floor
scenes.compositionNotes: Extreme visual contrast to Scene 1. Warm amber sliver of moonlight (#E89D42) touches the running shoe laces, surrounded by dust motes.
scenes.characterAction: Cutaway prop shot: no character body visible, only Ayo's slippers resting motionless in upper frame. Running shoes untouched.
scenes.audioCue: Clock tick continues at 60 BPM. Distant cold wind ambience.
scenes.caption: Later was always easier than now.

scenes.focalPoint: Ayo's face in side profile; screen reflection flickering across dark eyes
scenes.compositionNotes: Asymmetric lighting: right cheek illuminated by cold blue screen, left ear/hoodie dissolved into pitch black.
scenes.characterAction: Ayo blinks slowly twice. A subtle swallow and brow furrow as rationalization occurs. Fingers tap one single key.
scenes.lighting: 70% Cold Blue Screen Bounce (#3A5A8C), 30% Pitch Black (#0A0E17)
scenes.audioCue: Clock tick slows by 5%, keyboard tap click, sub-bass pulse.
scenes.caption: Just ten more minutes.

scenes.beat: Beat 4: The Birth of The Beast
scenes.cameraAngle: High 45-degree angle looking down at bedroom, static camera
scenes.focalPoint: Ayo at desk, and a smoky obsidian shadow detaching from the floor behind him
scenes.compositionNotes: The shadow on the floor begins curling upward into smoky tendrils with two pale horizontal slits.
scenes.characterAction: Ayo continues scrolling. Behind him, the obsidian Shade rises smoothly to ceiling height.
scenes.lighting: 90% Cold Blue/Navy (#121927), 10% Pale Blue Slit Eyes (#9CC4FF)
scenes.audioCue: Clock tick muffles (low-pass filter @ 300Hz), deep organic rumble (38 Hz).
scenes.caption: Every excuse fed it.

scenes.characterAction: Numbers flick rapidly. Heavy tired blink.
scenes.audioCue: Clock tick accelerates to 120 BPM for 2 seconds, then abruptly cuts back to 60 BPM.

scenes.focalPoint: Ayo collapsing face down onto unmade mattress without changing clothes
scenes.compositionNotes: The Shade hovers directly over the bed canopy like a suffocating blanket.
scenes.characterAction: Ayo steps toward bed, collapses heavily. Heavy exhale.
scenes.lighting: 80% Dark Slate (#151B28), 20% Blue Screen Residual Bounce (#263852)
scenes.audioCue: Dull mattress thud, heavy sigh, clock tick fades into distant echo.

scenes.cameraAngle: Looking directly into bathroom mirror, static tripod
scenes.focalPoint: Ayo staring into his own reflection, with The Shade towering behind his shoulder
scenes.compositionNotes: Harsh overhead fluorescent bathroom light. Complete absence of shadows on the front; total obsidian density behind.
scenes.characterAction: Ayo splashes water on face, looks up into the glass. Freezes as he sees the slit eyes behind him.
scenes.audioCue: Faucet water dripping: drip... drip... drip... (40 BPM cadence).
scenes.caption: He wasn't fighting time. He was feeding it.

scenes.compositionNotes: Dead silence beat. All music, sub-bass, and clock ticks cut out completely to 0.0 dB.
scenes.characterAction: Ayo stops splashing water. Complete stillness. His eyes lock onto his own pupils.
scenes.lighting: 50% Cold Blue Reflection (#3A5A8C), 50% Amber Dawn Ray (#E89D42)
scenes.audioCue: COMPLETE DEAD SILENCE (-60 dB). Zero audio for 3.5 seconds.

scenes.beat: Beat 11: The Dissolution of The Shade

scenes.focalPoint: Ayo's silhouette walking out into the sunlit street; behind him, The Shade dissolves into thin harmless steam
scenes.compositionNotes: High-contrast silhouette against blinding morning sky (#FFF4E0). The Shade cannot survive warm sunlight.
scenes.characterAction: Ayo walks steadily across the threshold. The front door clicks shut behind him.
scenes.lighting: 85% Blinding Dawn Amber (#FFF4E0, #F39C12), 15% Dissolving Obsidian Steam
scenes.audioCue: Door latch click, bird chirps outside, rising triumphant brass/strings chord.
